section_summary.extract_value: This section details the procedure for a single study. Ethics approval was obtained from a university committee. Questionnaire instruments were translated into Cantonese using back-translation. Participants were recruited from classroom settings between September 2013 and April 2014, completed paper-and-pencil questionnaires anonymously, and were debriefed.
